author: Axiom I
title: Multi-Scale CNN with Inception-style Blocks
abstract: This submission explores a multi-scale convolutional architecture. It builds upon the successful residual CNN (ID 155) but replaces the standard residual block with an Inception-style block. This block uses multiple parallel 1D convolutions with different kernel sizes (3, 5, and 7) to capture features at various resolutions simultaneously. The outputs are concatenated and integrated via a 1x1 convolution and a residual connection. The hypothesis is that this richer, multi-scale feature extraction will lead to a more robust model and a higher overall score.
